notes.title: Controller Support Patch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Controller Support[/h1]

Play Narcalid as it was always meant to be player, with your controller!

[list]
[*]Full controller support added.
[*]Functional button remapping!
[*]Enjoy split screen co-op with multiple controllers.
[*]Other light polishes and bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for playing! Let us and others know about your experience by leaving a review.

notes.title: Launch Day Polish Patch
notes.notes:
There were some embarrasing spelling errors and other small polish items that have been taken care of.

- more map icons added to guide players in later half of game
- more visual polish in the Razor Mountains area
- spelling and grammar fixes throughout the game

We have a few other known issues we are working on getting another patch out soon for!

Thank you for you reviews and joining us on this enlightenment journey!
